title: Backpack with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shoulder straps -->
  <rect x='20' y='26' width='10' height='30' rx='5' fill='#3A5FCD'/>
  <rect x='70' y='26' width='10' height='30' rx='5' fill='#3A5FCD'/>
  <rect x='23' y='28' width='5' height='26' rx='2.5' fill='#5B7FEF'/>
  <rect x='72' y='28' width='5' height='26' rx='2.5' fill='#5B7FEF'/>

  <!-- Main body of backpack -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='56' height='58' rx='12' fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <!-- Lighter edge highlight -->
  <rect x='24' y='32' width='52' height='54' rx='10' fill='none' stroke='#6AB0F5' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- Top flap -->
  <path d='M22 50 Q22 28 50 28 Q78 28 78 50 Z' fill='#2E6BB5'/>
  <path d='M24 50 Q24 30 50 30 Q76 30 76 50 Z' fill='none' stroke='#4A90D9' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Flap buckle / clasp -->
  <rect x='44' y='48' width='12' height='8' rx='2' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <rect x='46' y='50' width='8' height='4' rx='1' fill='#FFE066'/>

  <!-- Front pocket -->
  <rect x='32' y='60' width='36' height='22' rx='6' fill='#2E6BB5'/>
  <rect x='34' y='62' width='32' height='18' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#4A90D9' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Smiling face on the pocket -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='68' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='42.5' cy='69' rx='1.8' ry='2.2' fill='#1A2A4A'/>
  <ellipse cx='58.5' cy='69' rx='1.8' ry='2.2' fill='#1A2A4A'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 75 Q50 80 56 75' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='74' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='74' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Bottom handle/side tabs -->
  <rect x='36' y='86' width='28' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2E6BB5'/>
</svg>
